categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Carries the Fuzzing label and updates both the torcontrol fuzz harness and the DynSock test utility.
categories.rationale: Substantially increases fuzz coverage of Tor control connection wire parsing and authentication paths. The PR description notes that 'line coverage of src/torcontrol.cpp jumps from 52.2% to 81.8% and branch coverage from 47.5% to 74.0%' while also fixing a socket-lifetime bug in DynSock::Wait().
